_comment: Mutation testing: does the suite NOTICE a break? Coverage says a line ran;
this says a wrong line would have failed something. Stryker edits the source
(flips a condition, drops a call, swaps an operator) and reports how many of
Scope is the STATEFUL components — the ones whose promise is behaviour, where
a silent break is invisible: keyboard and ARIA contracts, focus traps, ranked
results. Mutating every presentational component would spend hours to prove
Run: npm run mutation   (slow, minutes — not part of the per-turn gate)
